Context span 2293-2312: X is the glueing of two copies of T along the affine open U; pi: X -> T maps U_i isomorphically to T and U_1 cap U_2 isomorphically to U; X is quasi-separated (Schemes, characterize-quasi-separated) and quasi-compact; for the closed points x_1 in U_1, x_2 in U_2 over t and the generic point etatilde in U_1 cap U_2 over eta, we have etatilde leads to x_1 and etatilde leads to x_2; since pi|_W: W -> T is separated, W cannot contain both x_1 and x_2 (valuative criterion, Schemes, valuative-criterion-separatedness); say x_1 not in W; then W cap U_1 is a quasi-compact (X quasi-separated) dense open of U_1 not containing x_1; via (T, t) = (S, s) this contradicts the first context span
core_obligations: The context glueing X is quasi-compact and quasi-separated
Suppose W is a separated quasi-compact dense open of X; the context valuative-criterion step forces W to miss one of x_1, x_2, say x_1
Then W cap U_1 is a quasi-compact dense open of U_1 = T missing t, which under the context isomorphism (T, t) = (S, s) contradicts the first context paragraph (no quasi-compact dense open in S - {s})
Hence X contains no separated quasi-compact dense open
proof_roadmap: Instantiate the context glueing X and check quasi-compact, quasi-separated
Run the context valuative-criterion dichotomy for a would-be W
Transport the surviving W cap U_1 to S - {s} and contradict the delivered L48311 construction
